veranderings.voor: geruil en ons noem dit ruilhandel
veranderings.na: geruil, en ons noem dit ruilhandel
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb (Mense het geruil / ons noem).
AWS comma before the second 'en', which joins two full clauses (Dit is hard en wit / mense kon dit kerf); the first 'en' stays without a comma.

veranderings.voor: Mense het van daardie glasperle later by Mapungubwe
veranderings.na: Mense het later van daardie glasperle by Mapungubwe
veranderings.rede: The time adverb reads more naturally straight after the verb, before the partitive object and the place.

veranderings.voor: gevolg en ons noem dit 'n handelsroete
veranderings.na: gevolg, en ons noem dit 'n handelsroete
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb (Handelaars het gevolg / ons noem).
AWS comma: 'en' joins two full clauses (Daardie mense het mekaar nie geken nie / tog was hulle verbind).
In Afrikaans people or places are 'met mekaar verbind'; 'aan mekaar verbind' suggests being physically attached.
Two coordinate adjectives of equal rank take a comma between them.

veranderings.voor: wanneer plekke ver van mekaar deel
veranderings.na: wanneer plekke wat ver van mekaar lê, deel
veranderings.rede: 'plekke ver van mekaar' is clipped and reads like a list of words; the relative clause matches the study text's own 'plekke wat ver van mekaar lê' and the comma separates it from the main verb.

vlae.teks: Party van die glasperle het uit Indië gekom. Hierdie lap is geweefde stof. Mense het van daardie glasperle later by Mapungubwe uit die grond gegrawe.
vlae.rede: The sentence about the cloth sits between two sentences about the glass beads, so 'Hierdie lap' points back two sentences and 'daardie glasperle' has to jump over the cloth; moving the cloth sentence up to follow the block's first sentence would flow better, but that span holds a protected wording, so it is left for the writer.

vlae.teks: Mense het van daardie glasperle later by Mapungubwe uit die grond gegrawe.
vlae.rede: 'later' is vague: a learner could read it as the people of Mapungubwe digging the beads up soon afterwards, while the next sentence implies a modern find (centuries later, by archaeologists); making that explicit would add content, so it is only flagged.
